text:
amy_sales: Heads-up — Sorin Health wants to run a POC next week. Theyve got a custom 30B variant 'sorin-30b-slim' and want Dedicated + Private for PHI. Asking for: quick compatibility scan, estimated monthly cost for a 2-week reserved window, KMS integration notes, and timeline for SOC2 questions.

devon_se: Got it. Do we have the model artifact + tokenizer details? Any quant preference?

amy_sales: They uploaded a tarball to a presigned URL. Tokenizer is SentencePiece with custom vocab (nonstandard unk handling). They prefer q8_0 for latency but open to fp16 for accuracy. Expected load: 60 rps peak, median 18 rps, avg prompt 300 tokens -> 200 response tokens. Want p95 <= 250ms.

devon_se: Quick flag: custom SentencePiece with unusual unk may change token counts and can slow tokenization if implemented in Python. Also q8_0 on a 30B model could need extra mem; we should check memory with tokenizer expansion.

nina_eng: For 30B + q8_0 + KV caching and that latency target, baseline recommendation is Dedicated cluster of 4xH100s with nvlink + 1 standby node for failover. If tokenizer inflates tokens by >15% we might need 6xH100. Can run a dry-run within 48h once we have artifacts.

omar_infra: I can provision a short-lived perf cluster. Need model and tokenizer binary, and a small sample corpus. Also confirm region (us-east-1 requested?) and whether they need customer-managed KMS.

amy_sales: They want us in us-east-1 and will use customer KMS. Also they asked about on-prem option if cloud doesn't meet audit.

redwood-deploy-bot: scan-queue: tools/model-scan --model s3://sorin/poc/sorin-30b-slim.tar.gz --tokenizer s3://sorin/tokenizer/sp-v3.zip --quick

drydevon_se: (typo) devon_se: ^ launching adapter check once scan returns.

ryan_sec: Security items: for PHI we require BAA, customer KMS integration docs, and explicit retention window for logs. Also need training-data provenance statement. If they insist on on-prem we need legal loop for a Private deployment SOW.

amy_sales: I'll push for the provenance and the SOC2 attestation. They said data is de-identified but will share the provenance doc.

devon_se: If the model uses any fused RMSNorm-like ops we may need an adapter layer. Also check positional embedding style (rope vs rotary) — rotary variants sometimes need kernel adjustments.

redwood-deploy-bot: model-scan started job-id rdb-scan-8622

redwood-deploy-bot: model-scan complete job-id rdb-scan-8622; result: compatibility-issues=3; report: /tmp/reports/sorin-compat.json

devon_se: Scan found three issues: custom unk-handling in tokenizer, a nonstandard rotary multiplier, and a weight-ordering mismatch in layernorm. Each is patchable: adapter + small tokenizer shim + kernel fallback. Est dev time ~2 days total to produce normalized artifact. Tokenizer expands tokens ~9% on sample corpus, so memory OK for 4xH100 baseline.

nina_eng: Perf job queued. Omar, please provision 4xH100 perf cluster and reserve a 48h window for tests. If perf meets p95 we can offer a 2-week reserved promo price.

omar_infra: Provisioning now, will share cluster endpoint and creds in DM. Expect ready in ~6h.

amy_sales: Pricing ask from customer: want estimate today for their procurement appendix (2-week reserved + possible month extension). Any ballpark?

nina_eng: Ballpark for 4xH100 reserved short window ~ $9,000/week with priority capacity. On-demand bursts ~ 1.8x hourly. If they go on-prem, add engineering onboarding + license ~ $55k one-time.

amy_sales: Noted, I'll label as preliminary.

ryan_sec: I'll draft a minimum security checklist for PHI POC: BAA signed, region locked to us-east-1, customer KMS + HSM keys, SOC2 report, training-data provenance, retention policy (logs >= 1y), and egress controls. Send to me the provenance doc once available.

devon_se: Plan for next steps: (1) run adapter scripts to normalize weights/ops; (2) build tokenizer shim container; (3) run perf harness with sample corpus. I can start (1) once model artifacts are downloaded.

amy_sales: Customer sent presigned links in DM.

redwood-deploy-bot: adapter-job queued: tools/adapter --input s3://sorin/poc/sorin-30b-slim.tar.gz --ops-fix rotary,layernorm --out /tmp/sorin/normalized.pt

devon_se: Adapter finished locally. Running scan + perf.

redwood-deploy-bot: perf-job started job-id rdb-perf-4412 on cluster perf-sorin-4h100

redwood-deploy-bot: perf-job complete job-id rdb-perf-4412; metrics: p50=78ms; p95=212ms; token-rate=~6200tps; memory-headroom=18%

nina_eng: Perf looks good — p95 212ms meets the <=250ms target with KV cache enabled. Recommend short reserved window for customer to run their workload.

amy_sales: Great news. I'll send a preliminary procurement blurb: estimated 2-week reserved cost $18,000 (prelim), on-demand multiplier 1.8x, timeline: adapters + security sign-off + perf = 3 business days.

ryan_sec: I requested provenance docs and SOC2 attestation from customer. Also flagged need for signed BAA before we ingest PHI.

amy_sales: I'll chase legal and the customer. Any blockers otherwise?

devon_se: None from SE. Will commit adapter and tokenizer shim to staging catalog once legal clears access.

amy_sales: Thanks team. I'll follow up with the customer and post updates here.
